final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget), kept AS (SELECT e.link_to_event, e.average_amount, e.average_amount - o.average_amount AS above_overall FROM event_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE e.average_amount > o.average_amount) SELECT link_to_event, average_amount, above_overall, average_amount - (SELECT AVG(average_amount) FROM kept) AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10
